Anthropic invited select investors to its San Francisco headquarters on October 14, ahead of an IPO that could value it at up to $2 trillion.

slides.headline: Anthropic's IPO could be worth *$2 trillion*. Its founders say they'll give 80% away

slides.heading: Wall Street comes to *San Francisco*
paras: Anthropic invited select institutional investors to meet senior management at its San Francisco headquarters on October 14, Bloomberg reported.
Investors cited by Bloomberg value the company at $1.8 trillion to $2 trillion. Formal IPO marketing could start the week of November 9, with trading before Thanksgiving.

image.credit: Algi Febri Sugita / SOPA Images / Getty Images

slides.heading: Who stands to get *rich*
paras: Fortune estimated CEO Dario Amodei's net worth at $15.5 billion in August. Anthropic has more than 2,500 employees.
Amodei's 2025 pay was $18 million, mostly stock and options, according to the IPO filing as reported by Cryptopolitan.

image.credit: Jason Henry / Bloomberg via Getty Images

slides.heading: The *80% pledge*
paras: Amodei and the other co-founders said in the filing that they would give away 80% of their Anthropic shares to charity.

paras.t: Amodei has warned about "a level of wealth concentration that will break society."

slides.heading: Big money, *bigger losses*
paras: Leaked IPO materials show 2025 revenue of nearly $4.6 billion, up about twelvefold in a year.
The same materials show a 2025 net loss of about $42 billion. The prospectus spends about 80 pages on risks, including "catastrophic or existential" ones.

slides.hook: The biggest IPO in AI history could land before Thanksgiving. Follow to see the first trade.
